text:
Nina (mkt): Need a tight benchmark narrative for launch assets — target infra + PMs. Two visuals max.
Sam (data): Recommend: (1) scatter: latency (ms) on x vs cost ($/1k tokens) on y, with P50/P95/P99 callouts; (2) compact routing diagram: fastpath vs econpath.
Eli (design): Keep headlines <=12 words. Use two clusters: quantized throughput vs unquantized quality. SLA bands as background color.
Priya (prod): Headline idea: 'Choose response speed or unit cost — not both.' Short webinar CTA below charts.
Nina (mkt): Bullets per visual: 2 each. Include a small token-cost example (label 'example').
Sam (data): Bench slices: chat-short (64) and long (1024). BenchBot queued job 91011. Will attach CSV when done.
BenchBot: job 91011 done — https://internal/bench/91011.csv
Sam (data): Quick numbers: chat-short P95=100ms, cost=$0.10/1k; long quantized P95=320ms, cost=$0.048/1k; long unquantized P95=770ms, cost=$0.13/1k. Quantized gives ~2.6x cost reduction on long contexts.
Eli (design): I'll produce: A) cluster comparison PNG, B) workload split PNG. Will add alt text and 1-line quantization legend.
Priya (prod): Webinar plan: 20-min demo + 10 Q&A; title: 'Serving LLMs: tuning latency vs dollars'. Promo: 1-line hook + 3 quick benefits.
Nina (mkt): Final checklist: 2 PNGs + alt text, headlines + two bullets, token-example, CSV datapoints, 1-line CTA. Target: EOD. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
